messages.content: I think I need to stop trying to fix my friend's problems and just listen instead.
Honestly, that's a genuinely mature realization. What made you notice you were doing the fixing thing?
They told me they just wanted to vent, not advice, and I kept giving advice anyway.
That's honestly a really common reflex, especially for people who care a lot - jumping to fix mode feels helpful even when it isn't what's asked for.
I'll try to actually just listen next time.
That's honestly the right instinct - sometimes just being fully present is more valuable than any solution you could offer.
